exposure: Adequacy of antenatal care (ANC) (≥4 visits vs <4 visits)
cohort: 226 mothers who gave birth at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Delta Medical College & Hospital, Bangladesh, from March 2023 to August 2023
finding: Adequate antenatal care (≥4 visits) was significantly associated with a lower proportion of adverse perinatal outcomes.
